name: George López
bio: George López (born April 23, 1961) is a Euro-Indigenous Latino American comedian, actor, and talk show host. George is of Euro-Indigenous Mexican descent. He is mostly known for starring in his self-produced ABC sitcom George López. His stand-up comedy examines race and ethnic relations, including the Euro-Indigenous Latino American culture. He is currently the host of the late-night talk show Lopez Tonight on TBS.
